action_items: Retired 8 pre-auth browser checks (dashboard-monthly-metrics, navigate-four-finance-areas, transaction-persists-in-extract, cards-crud-and-credit-link, installment-simulator-distributes, cards-dashboard-monthly, annual-view-year-matrix, export-transactions-csv) from a prior iteration: the app now requires login first, so they failed only because the matrix changed (auth was added), not due to a new defect. Their ground is now covered by authenticated-flows-preserved plus the login/demo checks.

checks.name: signup-login-logout-flow
checks.evidence: New user signed up with unique tscheck- email, sidebar showed name/email (account-name, account-email), logout returned to login-page, re-login with same credentials succeeded.

checks.name: demo-login-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: Logged in with demo.cashcontrol@emergent.dev / CashControl#2026, sidebar and dashboard rendered, zero non-favicon console errors captured.

checks.name: test_tscheck_user_isolation.py
checks.evidence: PUT /api/finance for user A with tscheck transaction id -> 200; GET /api/finance for user B excludes that id; GET /api/finance with no cookie -> 401. 2/2 tests passed.

checks.name: persistence-mongodb-reload
checks.evidence: Created unique transaction, awaited PUT /api/finance sync response, removed cashcontrol-finance-data-v1-<userId> localStorage key, reloaded page: transaction still visible, proving it was served from MongoDB via GET /api/finance.

checks.name: pdf-import-review-confirm
checks.evidence: Uploaded fixture PDF with line '15/01/2026 Mercado do mes 125,50'; pdf-review-card opened with row (description contains Mercado, amount 125.5); confirm added it to Extrato único (row text visible).

checks.name: test_tscheck_pdf_import.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/finance/pdf-preview with textual fixture PDF -> 200, rows=[{date:'2026-01-15', description contains 'Mercado', amount:125.5}].

checks.name: test_tscheck_pdf_validation.py
checks.evidence: POST .txt file -> 415 'Envie um arquivo PDF'; POST >10MB PDF -> 413; POST malformed PDF bytes -> 422 with detail message. 3/3 tests passed.

checks.name: entries-order-b3-classification
checks.evidence: boundingBox().y measured for quick-entry-card, b3-guide-card, card-registration-card, installment-card on /lancamentos; sorted order matched [Lançamento rápido, Classificação B3, Cadastro de cartões, Simulador de parcelas].

checks.name: authenticated-flows-preserved
checks.evidence: After demo login, navigated Dashboard mensal -> Lançamentos (transaction-form visible) -> Cartões -> Visão anual -> back to Dashboard via brand link; app-main rendered at each stop.
